## AI That Connects Listening, Learning, and Activation

Purpose-built AI agents turn employee insight into action, behavior change, and measurable workforce capability.

![Intelligent Nudges](https://go.perceptyx.com/hubfs/platform/screenshots/screenshot-intelligent-nudges-vertical.svg)

![Conversational Listening Agent screenshot](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/platform/ai-agents/screenshot-ai-agents-1.svg)

- **Turn Every Voice Into a Clear Next Step** Analyze feedback at scale to surface clear themes, risks, and priorities in real time.
- **Drive Behavior Change In The Flow Of Work** Deliver coaching, nudges, and next steps directly in tools employees already use.
- **Build And Measure Real Capability** Guide adaptive learning and validate understanding, so you know what employees can apply.
- **Turn Data Into Decisions At Scale** Synthesize signals into clear, manager-ready insights that move every layer of the organization in the same direction.
- **Identify Risk Before It Impacts Performance** Detect disengagement, attrition risk, and leadership gaps early with predictive signals.
